newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BECKHAM SYMPATHISES WITH SPURS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BECKHAM SYMPATHISES WITH SPURS.

text.p: Manchester United's David Beckham says he knows just how Tottenham Hotspur feel as they travel to Old Trafford this weekend haunted by recent 7-1 and 6-1 defeats.

United face Spurs in the third round of the English F.A. Cup on Sunday, eight days after the London side were hammered 7-1 by Newcastle and less than six weeks after they crashed 6-1 at first division Bolton in the League Cup.

"Obviously you are disappointed when that sort of thing happens but it is just one of those things," said Beckham, a key member of the United side hammered 5-0 by Newcastle and 6-3 by Southampton in October in a spell every bit as bad as Tottenham's.
"Every team gets it, even world class teams get it every now and then. We got it in a short space of time and hopefully it won't happen again."
Beckham, born in north-east London, came close to signing for Spurs as a schoolboy but was persuaded not to by his parents -- fanatical Manchester United fans.
Now he lines up in a United side widely expected to crush Tottenham on their way to the fourth round.
But Beckham warned against complacency, saying: "You never know what will happen. The cup is different from the league and I think it will just be a great game. I am looking forward to it."
